default_construction_type_reason: Typical unprotected wood-frame residential construction; other types remain in the table if a project specifies them.
national_average_note: ICC states these are average costs based on typical methods, a national average that does not take into account regional cost differences. Regional Cost Modifiers are subject to the authority having jurisdiction.
not_an_estimating_guide: ICC states the table is intended to help jurisdictions set permit fees, not as a project estimating guide.

pittsburgh_local_modifier.note: The former Bureau of Building Inspection is now the Department of Permits, Licenses, and Inspections (PLI). The 2026 PLI fee schedule (effective 1/1/2026) charges residential permits at $6.00 per $1,000 of construction value (min $130). It does not publish an ICC BVD square-foot table or a local multiplier on ICC BVD. Construction value is taken from the project; it is not a Pittsburgh-specific $/sf schedule.
